title: Consciousness vs Kundli
sub: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 1 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. The opening talk of a new series: how consciousness, not just remedies, changes the way each planet's dosha plays out.
desc: Complete notes on ASAP Ep. 1, Consciousness vs Kundli by Brajesh Gautam: knowledge versus wisdom, each planet reframed through awareness, gemstones as damage control, and a worked chart example, with video timestamps.
points: Knowledge has a ceiling, wisdom does not.
A guru is a guide to the next stretch of road, not a place to stop.
Ask from a sense of right, not from helplessness, to keep the Sun strong.
Every planet gets a consciousness fix.
Listening settles Rahu, feeding a dog settles Ketu, tidy storage settles Jupiter, and so on through all nine.
Mercury and Venus sit on a seesaw.
A level pair gives an ordinary mix of luck; a tipped pair swings between extremes.
It is damage control, not a source of success that was not already due.
A fixed share of life still plays out.
The speaker puts it at about 12 percent, regardless of status or faith.
The closing chart reading shows the method.
Retrograde and combust planets, and a house ruler's seat elsewhere in the chart, decide how a dosha plays out.
puts:
The pattern

Nothing in life feels balanced
